about: Lane F of the history fix (v5.1.2): the fold driver runs on tg_poll (compactTick at the end of pollJobs), one rung of the fold ladder per pump pass. Its paths are measured on their own so a deeper rung (the Mistral fold on the Small model, the OpenAI fold's retry) shows here first.

paths.name: fold pump pass (FoldDriver::tick)
paths._why: compactTick calls it once per pump pass: the start of a cycle (the slice read) and at most one rung

paths.name: fold rung (one request of the ladder)
paths._why: the request itself, under the model pin, on whichever wire the rung names
